name: My Zypps Cryo Half Ounce - Crunch Berries
description:
Infused and ready to roll. The My Zypps Crunch Berries half ounce delivers 14 grams of pre-ground flower, cryo-infused for extra potency and full flavor — no grinder needed, just scoop and go.

Crunch Berries brings that cereal-bowl nostalgia: sweet mixed berry and fruity cereal notes up front with a smooth, sugary finish.

14G pre-ground cryo-infused flower — half ounce, ready to roll straight from the bag
Cryo-infused — extra potency with a smooth, even burn
Signature Crunch Berries flavor — sweet berry and fruity cereal with a sugary finish

My Zypps Crunch Berries is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
